description:
As Certification Program Lead, you will join the Customer Education and Training team and will take ownership of the strategy, execution, and expansion of our current certification initiatives. Your core mission will be to elevate the Datadog Certified practitioner program into the leading industry credential for individuals and enterprises across observability, security, and the diverse technical ecosystems that Datadog supports.

What You'll Do

  • Own program direction, roadmap, and long-term planning.
  • Define growth targets for increasing practitioner and enterprise adoption.
  • Manage the program budget and vendor relationships.
  • Direct the production and publication of new exams, including maintenance and localization of existing content.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to keep certification criteria accurate as Datadog evolves.
  • Work with Datadog Partner teams on the development and delivery of certification exams for the Datadog Partner Network.
  • Envision, plan, and build promotion and engagement programs to recognize multiple-certified individuals.
  • Empower the sales team to sell certifications to enterprise customers.
  • Collaborate with Customer Education and other teams as they create certification prep workshops and learning resources.
  • Manage a small team of certification coordinators.

Who You Are

  • You have 7+ years of experience leading a certification program for developer-focused tools and products.
  • You have managed budgets, vendors, and complex project timelines.
  • You understand the lifecycle of exam development, from role scopes to subject matter expertise to working with psychometric consultants, to publication and localization.
  • You have worked with cloud engineering professionals and understand the professional skills required for devops, software development, and infrastructure monitoring.
  • You have managed a certification program that features both multiple choice and performance-based exams.
  • You are comfortable using AI tools to plan, validate, and accelerate business processes.

Benefits and Growth:

  • High income earning opportunities based on individual performance
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
  • Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions
  • Free, global Spring Health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+
  • Competitive global benefits, giving programs

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:
$255,000—$315,000 USD

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.
